//: The repo half comes last so a member's own compilerOptions win. Path aliases live there: without it the type gate resolved none of a member's src/external/* mappings, because the root tsconfig is a sibling of this chain rather than an ancestor.
//include: The fleet authors .mts, so these globs were .mts-only. `.opencode/plugins/` is the one dir where the extension is not ours to pick: OpenCode discovers ONLY .ts/.js there — measured, an identical .mts is never even attempted — and a TUI plugin rendering JSX must be .tsx. So NO .mts glob here; that extension is unusable in this dir and listing it would invite someone to add a file nothing loads. Entries are spelled out one per extension because tsconfig include does NOT support brace globs: `**/*.{ts,tsx}` matches ZERO files (verified), unlike oxlint, which does support them. Both failure modes are silent — a missed glob means the file is absent from the program and `pnpm run type` reports 0 errors for code it never read. The .tsx glob is deliberately absent: a TUI plugin imports `@opencode-ai/plugin/tui` and `solid-js`, which the HOST provides and this repo does not install, so including them reports missing modules for code that resolves fine where it runs.
